name: Sara Timberlain
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain stitches gear for the Stormwind Army. She makes useful armaments from salvaged cloth and leather.

sections.title: Needlework on the Frontier
sections.body: Sara Timberlain works with needle and thread outside a small cottage on the western edge of Eastvale Logging Camp. Axes sound through the camp as workers fell trees. Though Eastvale lies far from settled lands, wolves and murlocs prowl nearby, and Sara still offers travelers hospitality. She turns scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into sturdy gear. Her skill has earned official recognition and commissions to supply cloth and leather armaments to Stormwind's military forces.

faq.answer: Sara Timberlain is a skilled seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She makes practical gear from reclaimed fabrics and has contracts to supply the Stormwind Army.

faq.q: Where can I find Sara Timberlain?
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain sits outside a house on the western side of Eastvale Logging Camp, in eastern Elwynn Forest along the road to Redridge.

faq.q: Why is Sara gathering cloth for the army?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army depends on local crafters to maintain its equipment stores. Sara uses salvaged cloth, including linen gathered by adventurers, to make sturdy garments and armor linings for the kingdom's soldiers.

angles.text: Sara shows how frontier tailors make useful garments from scraps of rough linen and bandit cloth for military commissions.
Outlying settlements such as Eastvale help defend the kingdom, as local craftspeople supply basic armor to the under-resourced Stormwind Army.
